limitations.title: Trajectory availability is not guaranteed
limitations.finding: Reserve warning/critical thresholds are diagnostics; A can exhaust after sustained delays, failures, busy releases or rejection. Retained VIS A runs did not exhaust.
limitations.required_disposition: Additional fault/recovery and reserve-policy work needs separate review.

limitations.title: Fallback admission is not a nonlinear recovery region
limitations.finding: Admission and idle fallback computation require vx in [1,3] m/s and center corridor containment. Baseline targets centerline/2 m/s; scheduled linear LQR/PI evidence is not racing combined-grip recovery proof.
limitations.required_disposition: Define and verify the intended recovery envelope before extending claims.

limitations.title: Delayed asynchronous fallback coverage is incomplete
limitations.finding: No independent baseline-domain recheck at each delayed application. Application precedes fallback checks; plant diagnostics and RK4 guards still check held-pair propagation. Synchronous delayed-failure tests do not close async fallback coverage. Old-command/fallback, busy-tick, domain-edge and waiting/late combinations remain incompletely tested.
limitations.required_disposition: Separate reviewed tests and application-time safety design are mandatory before hardware.

limitations.title: Recorded center clearance is not continuous collision safety
limitations.finding: Soft 0.08 m NMPC margin, sampled center clearance and integration endpoints do not certify swept-body/obstacle containment or continuous corridor invariance.
limitations.required_disposition: Footprint, stopping distance and continuous safety validation remain future gates.

limitations.title: Synthetic termination is not an emergency stop
limitations.finding: No braking-to-standstill model/policy or independent hardware watchdog/safety supervisor. A simulation break is not physical fail-safe actuation.

limitations.title: Scientific operating coverage is narrow
limitations.finding: One synthetic circuit, one controlled A lap and one measured A lap; C70 measured run censored and two remaining cases unexecuted. No unseen-track or worst-case latency guarantee.
limitations.required_disposition: Preserve incomplete comparison; no further experiment authorized here.

limitations.title: Known C70 export defect remains open
limitations.finding: Nested NumPy boolean serialization after recorded exhaustion prevents final package/summary. Failed-worker thread observations, forecast match result, wall/CPU/RSS summary are unavailable. An expected-exception pass is not export success.
limitations.required_disposition: Nonblocking for bounded A baseline; blocks complete formal VIS package acceptance. Repair and missing-channel acceptance require separate review; no evidence fabrication.

limitations.title: Independent solver-build provenance is unavailable
limitations.finding: Locked CasADi3.8.1 and explicit IPOPT options are bound; no independently retained IPOPT plugin/linear-solver build identity. Same-host reproducibility is stronger than portable binary/timing equivalence.
limitations.required_disposition: Archive independent backend/build provenance in a separately authorized future environment qualification; do not infer historical defaults.

limitations.title: Synthetic model and perfect-state assumptions
limitations.finding: Vehicle/tire parameters are synthetic, not identified hardware. Width/length remain unknown; estimator/actuator uncertainty and communications are absent.

limitations.title: Predictor and host timing assumptions
limitations.finding: Original A predicts to release plus estimated delay with ideal future feedback timing and no committed prefix. Estimate cap is not a solver bound; readiness residual can compare different timestamps. Mac observations are not embedded hard-real-time certification.
limitations.required_disposition: Keep target-state prediction, readiness and accepted-handoff metrics distinct; no new architecture selected.

limitations.title: Launch and evaluation protocols are bounded
limitations.finding: Gated startup/preposition excludes prelaunch motion; VIS 5 ms codriver delay, replay pattern, two-crossing/80 s cap are evaluation conditions, not general profile capabilities.

limitations.title: Acceptance and broader interface work remain separate
limitations.finding: E3 verifies exact reviewed source and audits retained evidence; Primary acceptance/freeze, Workbench ingestion, broader failed-package acceptance and hardware gates remain pending.
limitations.required_disposition: No automatic next stage or status mutation of the proposed manifest.

items.requirement: Identify vehicle, tire, actuator and estimator uncertainty across intended envelope
Define and verify recovery or safe-stop domain, including braking to standstill
Application-time freshness, state/control validity and held-input reachability; expiry/pending-command ownership
Independent watchdog, communication/solver fault handling and fail-safe actuation
Continuous swept-body/obstacle clearance and stopping-distance validation
Target hardware timing, overrun/fault injection and end-to-end physical safety tests
Review E1 missing asynchronous fallback transitions, domain edges, busy ticks and honest fallback telemetry
